facts.text: The only ways to get to Aguas Calientes are by train or on foot; no roads go there.
facts.quote: by train or on foot — no roads go there

facts.text: From Aguas Calientes, you can reach the ruins by bus or by walking, which is a free steep hike.
facts.quote: by bus or walking (free steep hike)

facts.text: Frequent buses leave to the ruins starting at 05:30.
There are no vehicles of any kind in the park, so bring comfortable walking shoes.
facts.quote: There are no vehicles of any kind in the park

facts.text: Many of the paths are one-way, so you can easily miss a spot or be forced into the exit accidentally.
facts.quote: Many of the paths are one-way

facts.text: No walking sticks are allowed in the main area, except for visitors who have difficulty walking.
facts.quote: No walking sticks are allowed in the main area

facts.text: Most yearly rain falls during the rainy season, which in Machu Picchu is October to April.
The busiest periods are in the dry season from June to August.
facts.quote: The busiest periods are in the dry season (June–August)

facts.text: The wet season in Peru runs from November until the end of March, so it is best to include extra days for delays.
facts.quote: from November (often only really taking off in December) until the end of March

facts.text: The government caps the number of tickets to 5000 per day.
facts.quote: caps the number of tickets to 5000 per day

facts.text: Tickets bought in person may only be used the day after they are purchased.
facts.quote: only be used the day after they are purchased

facts.text: It is obligatory to bring your passport to enter Machu Picchu.
facts.quote: obligatory to bring your passport to enter Machu Picchu

facts.text: There are very high levels of UV-radiation, so take precautions.
Unless you have acclimated to the high altitude, you will likely be out of breath on any ascent.
facts.quote: Unless you have acclimated to the high altitude

facts.text: Bus tickets cost US$12 each way or US$24 round-trip for adult foreigners.
facts.quote: US$12 each way (Jan 2024), US$24 round-trip for adult foreigners

facts.text: A Machu Picchu ticket costs S/152.
Toilets outside the entrance cost S/2.
